stem: Which statement describes a criticism associated with the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA)?

options.label: A
options.text: It increased consumer prices for U.S. citizens.

options.label: B
options.text: It decreased the number of imports into the United States.

options.label: C
options.text: It contributed to the loss of U.S. manufacturing jobs.

options.label: D
options.text: It excluded many business sectors in the United States.
